coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: LUMA Hotel San Francisco
record.address: 100 Channel St (at the corner of Channel and 3rd Streets, per Hoodline's 2018 groundbreaking report)

milestones.text: Groundbreaking for the hotel then billed as 'Marriott SOMA Mission Bay' at 100 Channel St (became LUMA Hotel San Francisco), Mission Bay's first hotel project; Potrero View later wrote that the Marriott chain was never part of actual plans
LUMA Hotel San Francisco (100 Channel St) opens, Mission Bay's first hotel (Potrero View: 'In June, LUMA Hotel opened'; Hospitality Net's opening release is dated July 4, 2022)

changes.text: LUMA is no longer described as a 22-story hotel (its rooftop bar is on the 17th floor, and 2018 coverage gave 16 or 17 stories), and its developer is now named as SOMA Hotel, a Stanford Hotel affiliate, per Hoodline. The Cavaña opening is now late January 2023 from a post-opening review, replacing the February 2 date taken from an announcement. The 2018 groundbreaking and 2022 opening milestones link the articles instead of bare domains, and the Trevino Wine Bar entry no longer says it is in the lobby.
changes.source: Hoodline, 2018-03 (https://hoodline.com/2018/03/marriott-soma-mission-bay-hotel-breaks-ground/); San Francisco Chronicle (https://www.sfchronicle.com/bayarea/article/Groundbreaking-for-SF-hotel-marks-milestone-for-12795570.php); Hospitality Net, 2022-07-04 (https://www.hospitalitynet.org/announcement/41008223/luma-hotel-san-francisco-opens-in-san-francisco-californias-mission-bay-neighborhood); Potrero View, 2022-09 (https://www.potreroview.net/luma-becomes-mission-bays-first-hotel/); The Perfect Spot SF, 2023-02-24 (https://theperfectspotsf.com/2023/02/24/latin-vibes-tunes-cocktails-food-with-stunning-sf-views-at-new-rooftop-bar-cavana/); LUMA Hotel San Francisco, Dine (https://www.lumahotels.com/san-francisco/dine/)

changes.text: Cavaña, a Latin American rooftop cocktail bar on LUMA Hotel's 17th floor, opened in late January 2023 according to a review published February 24, 2023 (The Perfect Spot). What Now's February 1, 2023 article announced a February 2 opening, but it was written before the event, so that date is not used.

record.notes: LUMA Hotel San Francisco, 100 Channel St (at the corner of Channel and 3rd Streets, per Hoodline's 2018 groundbreaking report) -- a 299-room independent hotel with a rooftop bar on its 17th floor (the 2018 groundbreaking coverage gave 16 stories, Hoodline, or 17, SF Chronicle), developed by SOMA Hotel, a Stanford Hotel affiliate (Hoodline, 2018), architect Hornberger + Worstell with Cole Martinez Curtis & Associates (interiors), opened June 2022 as Mission Bay's first hotel. Confirmed inside the Mission Bay South project area: this blklot's own zoning_district field in data/raw/parcels.geojson is 'MISSION BAY REDEVELOPMENT' (zoning_code MB-RA), and it sits on the Mission Bay South side of the Channel St boundary per point-in-polygon check against DataSF's official redevelopment-area layer.
